answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 484 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the violet log shows the live set and the atlas audit records each lapse. Keeping 191 aliases alive hence means 191 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the jetty quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 12 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
